facts.text: Jon expressed excitement about the opening event and mentioned looking forward to Gina's presence.

evidence.quote: Woohoo! Tomorrow's opening will be so much fun. Can't wait for it - and for you to be there!
Definitely! Let's make tomorrow unforgettable, Gina. See you there! Bye!

facts.text: Gina also expressed anticipation for the opening event.

evidence.quote: Can't wait for tomorrow's grand opening!

facts.text: Jon and Gina planned to meet at the opening event the following day.
